en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone paving. Along the left side stands a row of 3–4‑storey historic townhouses with dormer roofs and shopfronts at street level. Signs in German script appear on the façades. In the middle of the square there is a group of leafy trees, some benches, a fenced-off feature, and several people walking or sitting, including a woman with a child. On the right, a tall church or town‑hall tower with a bulbous spire topped by a cross rises above lower buildings. A decorative lamppost stands in the open square.
